items.heading: Most Articles on This Topic
items.text: Most articles on this topic default to listing government and school librarian roles first because they are the most familiar. Ranked honestly by realistic pay ceiling and growth headroom instead, the order looks different: corporate knowledge management and digital archiving currently scale further than the traditional government route, because private employers pay for information systems that directly affect revenue, compliance, or research output, and those pay bands are not capped by a government pay matrix. The skill portfolio you build inside whichever track you pick, not the ranking itself, is what actually moves you toward higher income opportunities from here.
